title: Extending NUVO to Covariant Tensor Formalism on a Conformally Flat Background - Part 4 of the NUVO Theory Series
content: This paper extends NUVO theory by developing a covariant tensor formalism that operates within a globally flat but conformally modulated spacetime. Starting from the scalar field λ(t, r, v) defined in earlier parts of the NUVO series, we construct the covariant derivative, Christoffel symbols, and energy-momentum tensors under the conformally transformed metric gμν = λ2ημν. This formalism enables consistent coupling of tensor fields such as Tμν and Fμν...
